question: What contemplative visualization grants the power to shake the triple world?
premises: One should always contemplate a smoke-colored form.
The power to shake the triple world is stated as a result.
The instruction is addressed to the beloved.
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
uncertainties: The object that is smoke-colored is not explicitly named.
plain_english: O beloved, always contemplate what is smoke-colored, and you will be able to shake the triple world.
